title: Make the Bash guards' shell parsing follow wrapper options, ssh, fish, groups and find -execdir
prompt: The shell parser the Bash guard hooks share misreads some wrapped and remote commands, so the guards miss what they must catch. Make the failing tests pass: claude/hooks/shell.test.js, claude/hooks/guard-runtimes.test.js and claude/hooks/guard-git-push.test.js. Change the code, not the tests.
